title: Chapter 1872: Plotting Change (II)
content:
Chapter 1872: Plotting Change (II)

Daoist Master Baoxiang led him inside and seemed about to prepare tea. After his fright at Lesser Broadjade Mountain, however, Li Ximing wanted to conclude matters quickly.

He asked, "You must already know why I've come, senior... As for this [Wall-Sinking Water]..."

Daomian brought his hands together and replied solemnly, "Here in the Western Sea, that is not particularly difficult. With the methods of my Dao lineage, it can be produced in several places. Although most are no longer in our hands, we can approach a few fellow Daoists and make the arrangements."

Li Ximing sighed inwardly, then said, "Ideally, I would like a pool's worth each year... Roughly... a hundred portions."

"One pool... every year?!"

Daomian had known that a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator coming all this way would require a considerable quantity. A pool's worth was not excessive, but one every year was alarming!

He looked thoughtful and asked tentatively, "That would be rather more difficult. What would you offer in exchange, fellow Daoist?"

Li Ximing replied seriously, "Our homes are far apart, so I will send a Daoist Master to make the journey. Each time they come, they will supply your lineage with spirit materials of equivalent value. As compensation for your time and your work with Matter Transformation, you may request alchemy services or Purple Mansion Realm spirit materials."

Daomian seemed to have little desire for spirit materials. He sighed. "The Western Sea cannot compare with the Eastern Sea. I will find a way to gather the spirit water, but please allow me some time. As for compensation... there are these injuries of mine...

"I was wounded in battle and burned by Merging Fire. I have yet to recover. I've sought help from many quarters, but nothing has improved. They tell me that what I need is replenishment rather than healing. I need a pill."

Li Ximing began to understand. Daomian smiled. "I cultivate [Whole Pill] and understand transformations myself. I've prepared medicinal draughts from spirit items, but they are less effective than a refined pill. Please take a look."

He took a piece of silk from his sleeve, densely covered in golden writing. Li Ximing read it over several times.

"

Oh?

"

Li Ximing's mastery of alchemy was now considerable. Reading these profound teachings of Whole Pill brought sudden clarity and a wealth of inspiration.

Deeply intrigued, he exclaimed, "Fellow Daoist, this is remarkable!"

Daomian was unsurprised. "You are too kind. Whole Pill grants an understanding of Matter Transformation, so we do have some skill. There have always been many accomplished alchemists, but not all could write formulas that later generations could successfully follow. Of the formulas passed down, half were written by cultivators of [Whole Pill]. I have a little knowledge of alchemy myself, though I cannot compare with you."

This particular formula used [Valley Water] spirit materials, transformed with Pristine Water, then soaked and nourished in spirit water of Mansion Water before being refined into medicine. Its composition was extraordinarily intricate and ingenious. If successful, it could harmonize three forms of Water Virtue and produce effects far beyond those of the materials themselves. The actual process was not difficult, but determining the proportions could easily lead to repeated failures with nothing to show for them. No wonder Daomian had not attempted it.

Li Ximing, however, thought of the [Heaven's Will Single-Intent Method]. Once again, this secret art would prove invaluable. With its assistance, the formula became far easier to refine. Eager to put his skills to the test, he said decisively, "I will refine it for you, with the spirit materials supplied by you... As for the [Wall-Sinking Water]... I require six pools' worth!"

Naturally, he would not set the payment by the year. Gathering the water would only become harder over time, and eventually even two or three years might not suffice to collect the required amount.

Daomian silently calculated, then nodded. "Thank you, fellow Daoist!"

With that settled, Li Ximing went straight to the point. "Where is Lesser Broadsky Mountain?"

Daoist Master Baoxiang immediately answered, "Farther west. It is hardly a famous place. The abbot of [Temple of Gained Affection] simply shamelessly borrowed Lesser Broadjade Mountain's reputation when naming it."

Li Ximing asked doubtfully, "As a temple, does it have ties to Buddhist cultivators?"

Baoxiang noticed nothing unusual in his manner and smiled. "Very few. It is called [Temple of Gained Affection] because Abbot Shehu was once held captive by a Maha of the Emptiness Dao for many years. He escaped during a period of upheaval and has held a grudge ever since... So he established this [Temple of Gained Affection], and proceeded to enslave monks and abduct nuns as concubines. That is his particular taste."

Li Ximing's expression grew rather odd. He hesitated to speak, but Baoxiang continued as casually as though discussing something entirely ordinary. "He enjoys eating human hearts. He often sends the temple's nuns to seduce people into sexual cultivation, having them exert themselves fully through three rounds of lovemaking.

“Once the victim's blood is heated through with mana, the heart is immediately dug out, soaked in ice water, and sliced thinly. The slices release their juices from a touch of chopsticks, becoming fragrant, crisp, and delicious. Fortunately, he seldom indulges in wholesale slaughter or blood drinking, and otherwise keeps his conduct restrained. His reputation is quite good. People often call him a charitable man."

Li Ximing shook his head. "What a charitable man indeed."

Perhaps catching his meaning, Baoxiang glanced at the Daoist Master beside her and could only say, "The Western Sea is barren. For those who rise high, even food and clothing inevitably come stained with blood. Shehu leaves the people below him alone, so the Temple of Gained Affection actually has less blood on its hands..."

Baoxiang was young, after all, and Daomian immediately came to her aid. "Every region has its own rules. When the Origin Mansion was still around, even entering worldly affairs to govern was nominally considered the conduct of devil cultivators. It is difficult to draw clear distinctions."

Li Ximing had not expected a casual remark to prompt such explanations from them both. He smiled and said, "I have no ability to go around setting everyone's morals straight... Just how capable is Abbot Shehu, and how many friends does he have?"

Only then did a trace of hatred enter Daomian's eyes. "This demon has extensive connections. He is close friends with Chixi, a middle stage Purple Mansion Realm cultivator of [Western Mansion Origin Grotto Gate]. That is the greatest difficulty, as it could draw in several Purple Mansion Realm cultivators. Even if you choose a time when the others are away, Chixi remains at the gate all year round. He must be dealt with.

"There is also an old demon at the early stage of the Purple Mansion Realm in [Fangyazhou]. Besides that, Daoist Xiehu, a middle stage Purple Mansion Realm cultivator of [Sandalwood Plain Desert], owes him a favor... There may be others..."

The string of names gave Li Ximing an immediate headache. Baoxiang had fallen silent, leaving Daomian, who bore a grudge, to explain. Clearly, she wanted no part in this.

If all these people gather, success will be uncertain, and the fighting will certainly shake heaven and earth, drawing people from every direction...

He remained silent, but Daomian said quietly, "If you have made up your mind, fellow Daoist, then although my injuries make it difficult for me to fight, I know an old enemy of [Western Mansion Origin Grotto Gate], called Yinxin. He can hold off Chixi."

Li Ximing nodded slightly. An idea occurred to him, and he asked about the other middle stage Purple Mansion cultivator. "This Daoist Xiehu... what sort of person is he?"

Daomian said with a sigh, "He is one of the few who follow the Orthodox Dao. Though he cultivates [Supreme Shaman], he has lofty aspirations and refuses to use blood qi. He dislikes Shehu, but places great importance on friendship and an even greater importance on his promises... Though he is a friend of mine, I can seldom persuade him to change his mind."

Looking worried, he offered a warning rather than letting his own grudge drive him to encourage Li Ximing. "He is the most formidable figure to emerge in the Western Sea in recent years, and his cultivation is advancing rapidly. If you insist on killing someone before his eyes, you will offend him deeply... That may bring trouble in the future..."

With that, Li Ximing had formulated a plan. He smiled and said, "That is easily handled! I have a way to keep him from intervening."
